display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-14 Onboard renewable energy solutions and energy saving measures to reduce the fuel consumption of ships by at least 55% (ZEWT Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-14 Onboard renewable energy solutions and energy saving measures to reduce the fuel consumption of ships by at least 55% (ZEWT Partnership)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Innovation Action under the ZEWT partnership (Zero Emission Waterborne Transport) that funds a full-scale demonstration of combined onboard renewable energy solutions and energy-saving measures (for example wind-assisted or hybrid-electric propulsion, hull optimisation, energy management) that cut a ship's fuel consumption by at least 55% compared with 2008, with a methodology to estimate savings, retrofit-oriented design, digital integration, cybersecurity and safety aspects, up to TRL 8. Open to consortia under the standard Horizon Europe rules, excluding entities controlled from China; funded as a lump sum at the Innovation Action rates (70% for for-profit entities, 100% for non-profit). Indicative topic budget EUR 6.5 million for around one project. Planned opening 15 December 2026; single-stage deadline 14 April 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 8 (Climate, Energy and Mobility), pp. 245–248, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-14, funds a full-scale demonstration of combined onboard renewable energy and energy-saving measures that reduce ship fuel consumption by at least 55%. It does not touch TenneT's field: the work is confined to ship propulsion, onboard energy systems and ship operations, with port and shore-side aspects limited to safety and emergency cooperation, and no project file is close to it. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
